quests.title: A Scrollbound Skirmish

dialogue.section: Little Pinecone, Flammabomb Wood Figure, Vigee

dialogue.t: Although the Masked Warrior can't fly about like the Peacemaker, all she has to do to win is time her charges right!
You blithering idiot! You can't just think of how fast she can run in a straight line — if she can't turn or hit anything, it won't make any difference!
That's enough, children. We can have a civilized discussion, can't we?
We're being civilized...! It's just, well, when we talk about great warriors, we get pumped up!
Don'cha worry none, Miss Vigee! We might be at war, but we're gonna fight with reason and evidence!
...Oho! I just thought of a new strategy. I challenge you again!
Rematch, rematch!
A new customer! Hello there!
Judging by your attire, you're a traveler, aren't you? We've got that in common!
Do you want to try out this interactive woven scroll I've created with the children?

dialogue.sit: A scroll that moves on its own?

dialogue.t: Simply put, it's a game that combines Liyue's paper theater, Inazuma's comics, and Fontaine's film technology.
It's inspired by our local heroes, and adds the concept of "crossover challenges" to create a novel story.
Give it a try! Who knows, it might be a new experience for you.
Wonderful! Have a great time!

A new customer! Hello there...
Wait! I've seen your face woven into scrolls... you're that "Tum{RUBY#[S]Hope}aini!" all the children can't stop talking about!
Wonderful! I can't believe I got to meet someone like you... Anyway, honorable "Tum{RUBY#[S]Hope}aini," would you care for a chance to try this interactive woven scroll?

dialogue.sit: A scroll that moves on its own?

dialogue.t: Simply put, it's a game that combines Liyue's paper theater, Inazuma's comics, and Fontaine's film technology.

I'm sure it'll be an interesting experience. It might even be able to match the wondrous challenges you've imagined!
Wonderful! Have a great time! If you're free, please feel free to give me your feedback~

quests.description: Near the Children of Echoes, a creator is recommending her new game to the children…
